0022600096.text: The Orlando Magic (0-1, 4th in the Southeast, 1 game back, 10th in the East) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (1-0, 3rd in the Northwest, 7th in the West) in Orlando's second game of the season, with Minnesota coming off a road win. Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, but Orlando won both games in the 2025-26 season series and most recently beat Minnesota 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
